# Cat's Creations

> Cat's Creations is a graphic design and digital content studio based in Pretoria, South Africa, run by Cathy Viviers with a small team. It designs logos, brand identities, social media graphics, print materials, and digital assets for local and international clients, and is upfront about using AI tools (including Claude) as part of its workflow.

Cat's Creations serves clients in Pretoria, Gauteng, and across South Africa, as well as online worldwide. Cathy has a 5.0-star rating across 22+ verified client reviews on Upwork.

## Services

- [Logo & Brand Identity Design](https://catscreations.co.za/services/logo-brand-identity.html): Custom logo design, colour palettes, typography systems, and brand guidelines.
- [Social Media Graphics](https://catscreations.co.za/services/social-media-graphics.html): Posts, stories, banners, and templates for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and more.
- [Digital Content Creation](https://catscreations.co.za/services/digital-content-creation.html): Copywriting, captions, infographics, and digital marketing content.
- [Print Design](https://catscreations.co.za/services/print-design.html): Business cards, flyers, posters, menus, and print-ready files.
- [Brand Strategy](https://catscreations.co.za/services/brand-strategy.html): Brand positioning and identity strategy.
- [Web & Digital Assets](https://catscreations.co.za/services/web-digital-assets.html): Banners, email headers, digital ads, and presentation decks.
